degradation.conclusion: No sustained latency onset observed within the bounded tested range.
degradation.rule: Per workflow: at least 30 successes per stage, <=1% errors, p95 >= max(1.5x initial comparable p95, initial p95+10ms), confirmed at the next consecutive stage. Login has only one sample per plateau and cannot establish tail latency.

ramp.shape: stepped ramp; independently staggered clients at each plateau
limitations: Mixed HTTP menu, login, sales dashboard and customer status workload; not browser rendering or production capacity.
Virtual clients share three identities and one source IP; normal protection policies remain active.
No separate warm-up. Earlier plateaus warm the API/cache before later plateaus.
Resource peaks are sampled, not absolute peaks; byte/counter deltas span the first and last samples inside each stage.

monitoring.processScope: API and collector process; fixture generation shares this process during setup. Search clients run in a separate process.
monitoring.networkScope: Observed loopback HTTP socket bytes, including headers; not NIC/WAN or database protocol bandwidth.

dataset.assumption: Local expected-use planning baseline; not a measured production forecast.

checks: critical writes confined to fixture DB

resources.cpuModel: AMD Ryzen 5 PRO 4650G with Radeon Graphics

limitations: Versioned synthetic planning baseline, not a production forecast or capacity claim. Host resources are observations, not deployment allocations. Parent removes its owned cluster after exit.
